resources.string: Your chosen books, progress, and declines never leave the device.
Your consent covers only future weekly updates of five weights. Transmission is technically disabled pending a privacy, security, and legal review; books and history will not be sent.
Resetting deletes only the explicit recommendation settings and locally adapted weights. Books, progress, and playback history stay.
The explicit recommendation settings and locally adapted weights will be deleted. The library, progress, and playback history stay.
No proxy. Requests look like a regular browser on your phone.
An HTTP or SOCKS5 address — sources see the proxy\'s address, not yours.
Through Tor locally (Orbot, 127.0.0.1:9050). Orbot must be running.
Your self-hosted relay: sources see the relay\'s address, not yours. Trust goes to the relay operator.
Domain names travel encrypted to a public DNS, so your provider cannot see which sites the app opens. If DoH is unavailable — the system resolver works automatically.
Biometric verification is unavailable on this device.
Couldn\'t create the code. Check the internet and press «Show code» again. If the error persists, report it to the developer.
This build is not connected to Firebase. Update the app to the official release. If the version is already the latest, report it to the developer.
To show the profile recovery code
The code moves your profile to a new phone: install the app, open Profile, and enter the code. Showing the code requires biometric or device PIN confirmation.
Restoring replaces the current profile with the profile from the code. Books on the device are not deleted.
After confirmation, the app will restore the profile from the code. The current profile will be replaced, but the books on the device stay.
Couldn\'t restore — check the code and the connection.
A session lets you open books from this source without re-verifying. It is stored only in the app\'s browser and never synced anywhere.
For %1$s you will need to verify or sign in again. Other sources\' sessions stay.
Deletes all downloaded files from the device. This cannot be undone.
